name: o-json: read and copy the original shape

actions.label: Fold a collection
actions.caption: enter folds items in the original outline. Hide its fields so the surrounding document is easier to scan.

actions.label: Copy a field name
actions.caption: y k copies just the key items. Use it when you need the name without a full JSON path.

actions.label: Start jq with this path
actions.caption: ! i p puts the selected path on the jq line and runs it. Start a query from the field you already found.

actions.label: Copy the structure path
actions.caption: y p copies .items from the original shape. Paste the path into a query or another tool without transcribing it.

actions.label: Send a shape to the new structure
actions.caption: M opens the empty restructure page; s sends items and its fields across. Build a new structure from the source branch you selected.

actions.label: Write a new formatted copy
actions.caption: w opens the output chooser; switch to the typed path, write original.pretty.json, and enter. Make a readable copy while preserving the source.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
